experiment_name: First compliant DDQN training smoke (20 games, CPU) + seeded inference validation
exact_commands: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python scripts/run_baseline_match.py --focus "ddqn:<path>/artifacts/training_smoke/ddqn_hybrid_20_v2.pt" --opponents fixed-a fixed-b fixed-c --seed 42 --output docs/baseline_runs/inference_ddqn_smoke.json
result: Training+checkpoint+inference loop works end to end on CPU with zero ASU coupling (confirmed by grep across the full DDQN call chain, not just by not calling it). 2 crashes occurred and were fixed before the successful run, both environment/dependency gaps, not engine bugs (see notes). Checkpoint is not a meaningful policy (20 games, ~99% epsilon, 0% win rate) - this smoke proves plumbing, not agent quality.
notes: The 2 crashes: (1) 'Memory watchdog stopped training: Process RSS is unavailable' - psutil was not yet installed and Windows has no /proc or resource module fallback (fixed: pip install psutil). (2) UnicodeEncodeError on the epsilon (ε) character under Windows cp1252 console encoding (fixed: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8). Both fixed without touching the submodule; see docs/EXPERIMENTS.md 2026-08-10 entry for exact tracebacks. integrity.fallbacks is null at top level because the DDQN training loop's own history schema does not expose a fallback counter (fixed-opponent substitutions inside monopoly_game_engine/train.py are not logged); the inference-validation sub-run's fallbacks (15, all from fixed-a/b/c, 0 from DDQN) are captured in metrics.inference_validation instead. [2026-08-12 correction: code_commit_sha corrected to null — the clean-tree-before-run discipline did not exist when this ran, so there is no verified clean HEAD SHA at run time. For historical reference, this experiment was recorded in commit cf73b575131488170e735d67eaa57b672fbf8ece.]
